title: Permission prompt UI
goal: Ask the human for tool approval with a clear, safe terminal prompt that shows what, where and whose agent, uses the right keys, resists accidental approval, and works for both local requests and `approval.request` events from a session.
scope_in: `<PermissionPrompt>` box per DESIGN §10.1.4: title `Allow Cento to <verb> <object>?`, the exact command or path (up to 6 lines, then `⋯ +N lines (v to view all)`), `in <directory> (<branch>)`, agent name with owner initial + name, risk chip, expiry countdown, and the key row `[y] yes  [a] always for this project  [n] no  [e] edit command`.

Border `status.warning`; for `risk: "high"` and for destructive classifications from lane C016 (delete, force-push, deploy to prod) the border is `status.danger` and approval requires typing `y` then `⏎` (a bare `y` does nothing).

Key semantics: `y` = decision `approve` scope `once`; `a` = `approve` scope `always`; `n` and `esc` = `deny` scope `once`; `e` opens an inline editor (TextBuffer from lane C035) for the command; `⏎` alone never approves a non-destructive prompt either.

Mapping to the wire shape of CT-WS-SESSION-EVENTS: input from `approval.request` (clear `approval_id, agent_id, risk, expires_at, approver`; secret `summary, command?, cwd?`), output `{approval_id, decision: 'approve'|'deny', scope: 'once'|'session'|'always', reason?}` for `approval.decision`.
Queue of pending prompts shown one at a time ordered by `expires_at`, with `1 of 3` badge; the prompt box gutter in lane C035 turns `status.warning` while any prompt is pending.
Role awareness: only the host (and delegated approvers named by `approver`) see action keys; others see a read-only box `Waiting for <host name> to decide.`.
Optional terminal bell (BEL) on first display of a prompt when config `notify.bell` is true (default false).
scope_out: The permission engine, rules, always-rule storage and classification (lanes C015, C016).
Sending `approval.decision` over the wire and receiving `approval.request` (session client lanes).
Desktop or push notifications for approvals (notification lanes).
Any mascot: DESIGN §10.1.4 and §11.5 keep the mascot out of terminal permission prompts.
build_against: Pure component tests with prop fixtures and the pty/TUI snapshot tester from lane C008 (ink-testing-library plus pty harness, frames captured at 80x24 and 120x40). No backend is needed; any session data comes from contracts/fixtures/events/*.json or hand-built typed values from @centcom/protocol (lane C003). Uses the `approval.request` and `approval.decision` fixtures from contracts/fixtures/events/ and the permission engine stub of lane C015's public types; end-to-end with remote approvers uses the mock backend (lane C007) simulator.
interfaces: `<PermissionPrompt request: ApprovalView; canDecide: boolean; onDecide: (d: ApprovalDecisionInput) => void; onEdit?: (cmd: string) => void; now: () => Date />`

`type ApprovalView = {approvalId: string; agentId: string; agentLabel: string; ownerName: string; ownerSlot: number; risk: 'low'|'medium'|'high'; destructive: boolean; expiresAt: string; approver: 'host'|'owner'|'any_editor'; title: string; command?: string; cwd?: string; branch?: string; summary: string}`
`type ApprovalDecisionInput = {approvalId: string; decision: 'approve'|'deny'; scope: 'once'|'session'|'always'; editedCommand?: string; reason?: 'user'|'expired'|'interrupted'}`
`<PermissionHost queue: ApprovalView[]; ... />` which sequences prompts; `approvalFromEvent(p: ApprovalRequestClear, s: ApprovalRequestSecret): ApprovalView`
acceptance: Snapshot at 80x24 matches the DESIGN §10.1.4 anatomy: title, command, `in ~/centcom (agent/feature-retry)`, blank row, key row; box width is `min(cols-2, 78)`.
For `risk:'low'|'medium'` pressing `y` calls `onDecide` once with `{decision:'approve', scope:'once'}`; `a` -> scope `always`; `n` and `esc` -> `{decision:'deny', scope:'once'}`.

For a destructive prompt (`high` risk or `destructive:true`) the border token is `status.danger`; pressing `y` alone shows `Type y then Enter to confirm.` and does not call `onDecide`; `y` then `⏎` within 5 s approves; any other key cancels the arming.
Keystrokes arriving within 300 ms after a prompt first renders are ignored (type-ahead protection), proven by a test that feeds `y` 100 ms after mount and expects no decision.
At `expires_at` the prompt auto-resolves with `{decision:'deny', reason:'expired'}`, the box dims and shows `Expired`; the remaining time is shown as `expires in 4:32` and updates once per second.
With `canDecide=false` no key row is rendered, key presses do nothing, and the box reads `Waiting for <name> to decide.`.
`[e]` is shown only when `onEdit` is provided (local host); the edited command is returned in `editedCommand` and the decision is `approve` `once`.
Command text containing bidi override `\u202E`, zero-width characters or ESC sequences is shown with visible escapes (e.g. `\u{202E}`), so the user sees exactly what will run.
With 3 pending prompts the badge reads `1 of 3`; answering the first shows the next within one frame.
Under `NO_COLOR` the risk is conveyed by words `risk: high` and the destructive border by heavy box characters `┏━┓`.
tests: permission/keys.test.ts: all key paths incl. destructive arming and type-ahead window with fake clock.
permission/untrusted-text.test.ts: bidi, zero width, ANSI in command and cwd.
permission/event-mapping.test.ts: fixtures to ApprovalView and decision to schema-valid payload.
guardrails: MUST NEVER make the destructive action the default; `⏎` with nothing armed does nothing, and focus never starts on `y`.
MUST show what (exact command or path), where (directory and branch) and whose agent (owner name + initial) in every prompt (DESIGN §10.1.4).
MUST ignore input during the 300 ms type-ahead window and MUST clear any buffered keys when a prompt appears, so text typed into the prompt box cannot approve an action.
MUST NOT truncate the command silently: hidden lines are announced as `⋯ +N lines` and `v` shows the full text before deciding.
MUST enforce expiry locally using `expires_at`; an expired prompt can never be approved.
MUST NOT claim authority the user lacks: the UI mirrors CT-RBAC for display only; the host/server decides, so a decision from a non-approver is simply rejected upstream.
MUST NOT show the mascot and MUST NOT use joke copy in this component (DESIGN §11.5).
failure_modes: `expires_at` already in the past on arrival -> render as expired and immediately emit the auto-deny; do not flash an actionable prompt.
Missing secret part (`command` absent) -> show `summary` only and hide `[e]`.
Decision callback throws or the send fails -> keep the prompt open, show `Couldn't send your answer. Try again.`, and re-enable keys.
